articles.title: Man stabbed in North York, female suspect fled the scene: Toronto police
articles.summary: Toronto police are on the hunt for a woman who fled the scene of a stabbing in North York on Saturday morning. articles.title: Toronto masseur, 53, charged with sexual assault
articles.summary: A masseur in Toronto has been charged in connection with an alleged sexual assault that took place last weekend. According to investigators, 53-year-old Jiquan Liu was working as a masseur in Chinatown, near Spadina Avenue and Dundas Street West. The victim went for a massage and then told police they were sexually assaulted during the […]

articles.title: Toronto police seek 3 suspects in Weston shooting
articles.summary: Toronto police are on the hunt for three suspects who are wanted in connection with a shooting that happened in the Weston area overnight. Officers were called to the area of Church Street and Weston Road just before 4 a.m. on Saturday for reports of gunshots. Detectives located evidence of gunfire at the scene, but […]

articles.title: Weekend and vacation work needed at Federal Court due to high caseload: chief justice
articles.summary: OTTAWA — A massive increase in immigration cases in the last six years has created unmanageable workloads at the Federal Court, says Chief Justice Alan Diner.

articles.title: Family alleges fare inspectors used excessive force on Black man with disabilities in Newmarket
articles.summary: A Newmarket mother is alleging her 21-year-old son with disabilities was the victim of excessive force and racial profiling at the hands of fare inspectors on York Region Transit. The Canadian Civil Liberties Association says the case highlights the need for greater oversight of law enforcement on public transit.

articles.title: ‘Bike lanes save lives’: Cyclists rally against the removal of downtown bike lanes
articles.summary: Dozens of cycling advocates filled the streets of downtown Toronto as part of a ride organized in response to a recent court ruling allowing the Ford government to rip out 19 km of protected bike lanes

articles.title: Police say man critically injured in downtown stabbing
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating after a man in his 40s was found suffering from stab wounds in the downtown area. Investigators say the incident took place at Dundas Street West and Augusta Avenue just after 8 p.m. The man was taken to the hospital with injuries described as life-threatening. No suspect description was immediately available.

articles.title: Seneca Nation calls for reversal of Trump’s ‘Lake America’ executive order
articles.summary: The leader of the Seneca Nation in upstate New York is criticizing President Donald Trump's decision to rename Lake Ontario as “Lake America,” saying it violates a more than 225-year-old treaty and shows a “blatant disrespect” for the Indigenous people who gave it its name in the first place.

articles.title: Mississauga man facing almost 40 charges related to theft of clothes and accessories
articles.summary: A 49-year-old Mississauga man is facing almost 40 charges following a multi-jurisdictional organized retail theft investigation. Police in Peel Region say they started an investigation in April targeting a prolific offender believed to be responsible for at least 38 theft-related incidents involving clothes and accessories from major retail outlets in Peel, Halton, Durham, Hamilton, York […]

articles.title: Man in his 60s dead after two vehicles collide in Brampton, police say
articles.summary: A man in his 60s is dead following a two-vehicle collision in Brampton, Ont., Friday, police say.

articles.title: Andreescu, fellow Canadian Draxl lose in final round of U.S. Open qualifying
articles.summary: No Canadians will enter the singles draws at the U.S. Open through the qualifying tournament after Bianca Andreescu and Liam Draxl lost in final round action Friday in New York.

articles.title: Ontario's top court sides with lower court, rejects developer's challenge over Greenbelt land
articles.summary: The Ontario Court of Appeal has sided with a lower court in rejecting a developer's constitutional challenge of a 2023 law that returned 15 parcels of land to the Greenbelt.

articles.title: York police set up command post for missing vulnerable person in Markham, Ont.
articles.summary: York police say they have set up a command post for a missing vulnerable person in Markham, Ont., Friday.

articles.title: Toronto police seek public's assistance in hit and run near Junction-Wallace Emerson
articles.summary: Toronto police say they are seeking the public's assistance with a fail to remain collision near the Junction-Wallace Emerson area on Wednesday evening.

articles.title: 'A swing and a drive' for Buck Martinez as Blue Jays induct him into Hall of Excellence this weekend
articles.summary: The Blue Jays will be inducting longtime broadcaster Buck Martinez into the team's new Hall of Excellence on Saturday in a ceremony at Rogers Centre.

articles.title: Police investigating suspected arson after cars at Liberal MP's home torched
articles.summary: Police are investigating a suspected arson at the home of a Scarborough MP after multiple cars were torched early Thursday, CBC News has learned.
